description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ValidatorException' used within the OrangeHRM project's API validation layer. It extends PHP's base Exception class and provides a default error message, facilitating specific error handling related to validation issues.

classes.name: ValidatorException
classes.description: A custom exception class for validation errors, with a default error message and constructor to pass message, code, and previous exception.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ValidatorException with an optional custom message, code, and previous exception. Uses default message if none provided.
